cases.name: CHK-011: migrate chain links for multi-case fixture
CHK-011: runner uses nextCaseId after migrate
CHK-011: single case fixture no chain
CHK-011: existing chain not overwritten
cases.execute: const f1=$handlers.fixture_get({fixturePath:"fixture-chain"}); const origNext=f1.cases[0]?.nextCaseId; $handlers.fixture_migrate(); const f2=$handlers.fixture_get({fixturePath:"fixture-chain"}); return f2.cases[0]?.nextCaseId===origNext ? "not_overwritten" : "overwritten"

cases.name: CHK-011: missing _id reports error
CHK-011: reorder then migrate
CHK-010-h0: migrate adds _id to all cases
CHK-010-h1: post-migrate all ids unique
cases.execute: const f=$handlers.fixture_get({fixturePath:"fixture-uuid"}); const ids=f.cases.map(c=>c._id).filter(Boolean); return new Set(ids).size===ids.length && ids.length>0 ? "all_unique" : "not_unique"

cases.name: CHK-010-e0: existing _id preserved
cases.execute: const before=$handlers.fixture_get({fixturePath:"fixture-uuid"}); const origId=before.cases[0]._id; $handlers.fixture_migrate(); const after=$handlers.fixture_get({fixturePath:"fixture-uuid"}); return after.cases[0]._id===origId ? "preserved" : "changed"
